title: Flight
description: Flight information with airline, route (origin/destination), departure/arrival times, duration, aircraft, pricing, available seats, class, and status. Used for flight booking platforms, airline systems, and travel management applications.

flight_number.description: Flight number or code (e.g., AA123, DL456)

origin.description: City or airport name of departure location

origin_code.description: IATA airport code for the origin airport (e.g., JFK, LAX, LHR)

destination.description: City or airport name of arrival location

destination_code.description: IATA airport code for the destination airport

aircraft.description: Aircraft model or type (e.g., Boeing 737, Airbus A320)

currency.description: ISO currency code for the price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

available_seats.description: Number of seats currently available for booking

status.description: Flight status (e.g., scheduled, boarding, departed, arrived, delayed, cancelled)
